This unidentified '''battle droid''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] under the direct command of [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], alongside [[O.M.5/Legends|O.M.5]] and another B1 battle droid, escorted [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Poggle's [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] with two winged [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)|warriors]]. After losing a munitions crate, this droid and O.M.5 began marching behind Poggle's tank. They were caught up in a sandstorm, which first caused them to lose sight of one another. First the other battle droid, and then O.M.5 was buried and left behind in the storm, and despite the remaining commander's shouts to try and locate O.M.5, Lord Poggle ordered them to press onward. He soon stopped functioning as well and was also buried in the sand, unable to stand up to the storm as the Geonosians continued onward to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]].<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

==Characteristics==
This battle droid showed some concern when O.M.5 disappeared, but followed Poggle's orders to keep going.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

==Behind the scenes==
This B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
